nodes.label: CLAUDE.md (project instructions)
nodes.rationale: Authoritative project memory: three-layer split status, EF ironclad rules, external Redis channel contracts, 150-line cap and institutional clauses.

nodes.label: Horizontal Scaling Plan (Redis Streams)
nodes.rationale: Authoritative redo design for splitting one process into Scraper/Notifier/Coordinator; user decided Redis Streams over RabbitMQ to avoid operating an extra service.

nodes.label: Letter to Future Sessions
nodes.rationale: Onboarding letter: warns claude branch is asset+trap, work happens beside a live production system, decisions are settled and must not be re-litigated; documents four institutional decay modes.

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml (method A, fixed shards)
nodes.rationale: App-only stack; single image with ROLE env selecting the exe; MySQL/Redis are external via host.docker.internal; internal bus is Redis Streams so no extra broker service.

nodes.label: Build workflow (SonarQube analysis)
nodes.rationale: GitHub Actions build + dotnet-sonarscanner analysis; trigger branch set to 'none' (effectively disabled).

nodes.label: HelpDescription (bot feature summary)
nodes.rationale: User-facing help: YouTube/TwitterSpace/TwitCasting/Twitch stream notifications, membership verification, banner change; authoritative docs live in Notion.

nodes.label: Three-layer split architecture
nodes.rationale: Split one process into Scraper (cluster-singleton), Notifier (horizontally scalable shards), Coordinator (lightweight); each is its own project referencing only Shared. Detection is singleton so API quota is not multiplied by shard count; notification sending is spread across shards.

nodes.label: Scraper layer (detection host)
nodes.rationale: Owns all polling timers, recording Redis subscriptions, PubSub/EventSub; publishes structured DTOs to bot:notify; never touches Discord gateway; grabs scraper leader lock so only one runs.

nodes.label: Notifier layer (Discord shard)
nodes.rationale: Builds DiscordSocketClient, runs slash + prefix command systems, consumes its consumer group, rebuilds embeds, and only sends to guilds it owns; holds all GetGuild actions.

nodes.label: Coordinator layer (control plane)
nodes.rationale: Lightweight coordinator: heartbeat monitoring, leader lock observation, TOTAL_SHARDS announcement, XPENDING backlog monitoring. Does NOT restart processes — Docker Compose does that.

nodes.label: Shared library
nodes.rationale: Common base with no Discord gateway logic: BotConfig, DataBase/+Migrations, Auth, RedisChannels, NotificationBus, Messages DTOs, stateless *ApiService, BotState, StartupPreflight, GracefulShutdown.

nodes.label: Redis Streams notification bus (bot:notify)
nodes.rationale: Single stream bot:notify, one consumer group per shard (shard-{id}) so each group receives all messages (broadcast + self-filter); XADD MAXLEN ~ trimming; at-least-once. Chosen over RabbitMQ to add zero packages/services (built into StackExchange.Redis).

nodes.label: NotificationBus (Streams wrapper)
nodes.rationale: Wraps XADD/XREADGROUP/XACK/XAUTOCLAIM; PublishAsync XADDs to bot:notify. Short-poll loop (1-2s) because StackExchange.Redis does not support blocking XREADGROUP BLOCK.

nodes.label: NotifyType (bus type contract)
nodes.rationale: static class of const string type tags (youtube/twitch/twitcasting/banner); publisher and consumer must agree, use the constant not a literal.

nodes.label: Messages DTOs (cross-layer notifications)
nodes.rationale: YoutubeNotification/TwitchNotification/TwitcastingNotification/BannerChangeNotification: pass structured data, never serialize Embed; wire enum separate from UI enum with matching member order.

nodes.label: Per-shard consumer group (shard-{id})
nodes.rationale: One group per shard, one consumer per group (notifier-{id}); created from 0 with MKSTREAM so first deploy misses no messages; history replay absorbed by dedup key.

nodes.label: NotificationBusConsumer
nodes.rationale: Short-poll loop + DispatchAsync switch on type + dedup key + XACK + XAUTOCLAIM. Unwired type prints '尚未接線的 type' warn then acks — silently dropped.

nodes.label: Shard ownership guard (IsServerOnThisShard)
nodes.rationale: Discord formula (guildId >> 22) % totalShards == shardId. On GetGuild==null: silently skip if not this shard's guild; only delete config if owned and still missing after Ready. Prevents multiple shards deleting each other's notification settings. Stage 0 stop-the-bleed PR fixing 5 unconditional-delete sites.

nodes.label: Scraper leader lock
nodes.rationale: SET cluster:scraper:leader NX EX; holder renews; on lock loss the scraper exits to avoid double detection. Ensures detection is a cluster singleton.

nodes.label: Heartbeat / control-plane keys
nodes.rationale: cluster:heartbeat:{role}:{id} with TTL; Coordinator scans them; leader-lock TTL expiry triggers Compose restart of a new scraper instance.

nodes.label: GracefulShutdown (SIGTERM handling)
nodes.rationale: docker stop sends SIGTERM but Console.CancelKeyPress only catches SIGINT, so cleanup (save DB, Unsubscribe) would not run. Unified via PosixSignalRegistration; all long loops consume its CancellationToken.

nodes.label: StartupPreflight (connection checks)
nodes.rationale: Per-role probing of external services with exponential backoff; on final failure prints service/host:port/reason then Exit(1), leaving restart to Compose.

nodes.label: Cross-shard commands (3 Redis mechanisms)
nodes.rationale: Discord routes all DMs to shard 0 and each notifier only holds its own guilds. Solved with (A) broadcast action pub/sub, (B1) shared HASH snapshot, (B2) correlationId request/reply — no gRPC/service discovery introduced.

nodes.label: ClusterQueryService
nodes.rationale: B1 ReadMergedGuildsAsync/WriteGuildSnapshotAsync + B2 RequestAsync/CollectAsync over cluster:query:request. AdministrationService depends on it (one-way).

nodes.label: AdministrationService (broadcast owner cmds)
nodes.rationale: Mechanism A: subscribes and broadcasts shutdown/leaveGuild/leaveNoNotify; each shard acts on its own guilds and rebuilds embeds locally.

nodes.label: Redis pub/sub IPC (external contract)
nodes.rationale: youtube.startstream/record/pubsub.*, twitch.*, twitcasting.pubsub.startlive are the cross-repo contract with the external recorder and webhook backend. Code may move, strings must not change.

nodes.label: YoutubeMemberService (off-bus)
nodes.rationale: Membership checks stay entirely in Notifier and do NOT use the bus: shard guard naturally partitions members per shard (OAuth quota auto-shared), role ops are REST not gateway-bound, and many result branches make DTO-ization high-risk zero-gain.

nodes.label: Docker Compose deployment (method A / B)
nodes.rationale: Method A = fixed shard services (command [id,total]), simple and independently restartable. Method B = --scale + shard lease (SET cluster:shard:lease:{i} NX EX) once the coordinator lease matures.

nodes.label: Single multi-stage image, ROLE-selected exe
nodes.rationale: One Dockerfile publishes three exes to /app/{scraper,notifier,coordinator}; entrypoint picks by $ROLE (Notifier forwards [ShardId,TotalShards]). Avoids the three-Dockerfile detour.

nodes.label: claude branch (RabbitMQ reference impl)
nodes.rationale: Complete compilable RabbitMQ-based split (55 commits) — read-only reference via git show, never merged/cherry-picked/checked out. RabbitMQ vetoed for operational cost; the redo is from master with Redis Streams.

nodes.label: EF Migrations baseline (do not regenerate)
nodes.rationale: Production __EFMigrationsHistory records claude-branch migration IDs; Migrations/ must be copied wholesale (never migrations add regenerated) or Migrate() would try to rebuild existing tables. Baselined 2026-06; EnsureCreated banned; prod applies idempotent Script-Migration only.

nodes.label: At-least-once + dedup key
nodes.rationale: Streams are at-least-once so duplicates possible; after successful send write short-lived dedup key notified:{videoId}:{noticeType}; XAUTOCLAIM redelivery finds the key and acks/skips. Un-acked messages stay in PEL for XAUTOCLAIM recovery.

nodes.label: PeriodicRunner (non-reentrant polling)
nodes.rationale: PeriodicTimer-based fixed-interval runner, no re-entrancy, consumes CancellationToken; replaces raw polling for detection timers.

nodes.label: NoticeCache (TTL notification settings cache)
nodes.rationale: TTL ~30s + invalidate-on-change; reduces MySQL pressure from broadcast fan-out when sending.

nodes.label: add-detection-platform skill
nodes.rationale: Recipe to add a platform/notification event across Shared (DTO/NotifyType/channels/API) -> Scraper/Detection (publish DTO) -> Notifier/SharedService (consume, rebuild embed, shard-guarded send). Warns membership does NOT use the bus.

nodes.label: debug-detection-bus skill
nodes.rationale: Traces a notification from detection to Discord and diagnoses missing/dropped/duplicate notifications along Scraper -> PublishAsync -> bot:notify -> consumer group -> DispatchAsync -> GetGuild shard guard; distinguishes bus from external pub/sub IPC.

nodes.label: ef-migration-baseline skill
nodes.rationale: Project EF specifics: tooling targets Shared (MainDbContextFactory design-time factory), connection-string resolution order, snake_case convention, prod always Script-Migration, one-time _Baseline_ExistingDb.sql; four inheriting YouTube video tables share Video base.

nodes.label: DetectionHost (Scraper composition root)
nodes.rationale: ServiceCollection registers each XxxDetectionService and GetRequiredService instantiates it (constructor starts the timer/subscription).

nodes.label: EmbedBuilderFactory (per-platform embeds)
nodes.rationale: Notifier rebuilds embeds from DTOs using WithOkColor/WithErrorColor/WithRecordColor; consume side has no timer/detection logic.

nodes.label: graphify skill (/graphify)
nodes.rationale: Turns any folder into a navigable knowledge graph with community detection and an EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS audit trail; outputs interactive HTML, GraphRAG JSON, and GRAPH_REPORT.md. Needs no API key; code is AST-extracted for free.

nodes.label: Knowledge graph (graph.json)
nodes.rationale: Persistent queryable graph of nodes+edges+hyperedges across sessions; #479 shrink-guard refuses to clobber a larger existing graph.json.

nodes.label: AST structural extraction (Part A)
nodes.rationale: Deterministic, free, no LLM/key; a code-only corpus skips semantic extraction entirely.

nodes.label: Semantic extraction (parallel subagents)
nodes.rationale: For docs/papers/images only; dispatch general-purpose subagents in one message (must have Write access) or use Gemini if GEMINI_API_KEY set. Never reads ANTHROPIC/OPENAI keys.

nodes.label: Community detection & clustering
nodes.rationale: Clusters graph, scores cohesion, surfaces cross-document connections; communities are hand-labeled 2-5 words in Step 5.

nodes.label: God nodes & surprising connections
nodes.rationale: High-degree bridge nodes plus surprising connections and suggested questions pasted from GRAPH_REPORT.md; used to guide exploration.

nodes.label: Extraction subagent prompt spec
nodes.rationale: Verbatim subagent prompt: JSON schema, deterministic node-ID rules, confidence rubric, frontmatter propagation, hyperedge and vision rules; this very chunk was extracted under it.

nodes.label: Confidence rubric (EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS)
nodes.rationale: Discrete confidence_score set (1.0 EXTRACTED; 0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55 INFERRED; 0.1-0.3 AMBIGUOUS); avoids the observed bimodal 0.5/0.85 collapse.

nodes.label: query / path / explain traversal
nodes.rationale: BFS/DFS traversal with required vocab-constrained query expansion (no invented tokens), NetworkX fallback, save-result feedback loop, and reflect/LESSONS.md work memory.

nodes.label: Incremental update / cluster-only
nodes.rationale: Re-extracts only changed files; code-only changes skip semantic extraction; build_merge replace-on-re-extract + prune_sources for deletions; cluster-only is self-contained.

nodes.label: Post-commit hook & CLAUDE.md integration
nodes.rationale: graphify hook install rebuilds graph after each commit via git diff HEAD~1 AST re-extraction; graphify claude install writes the always-on CLAUDE.md section.

nodes.label: Exports (Neo4j/FalkorDB/wiki/SVG/GraphML/MCP)
nodes.rationale: Flag-gated exporters plus a stdio MCP server exposing query_graph/get_node/shortest_path etc., and a token-reduction benchmark for corpora over 5000 words.

nodes.label: Whisper transcription (video/audio)
nodes.rationale: Transcribes video/audio to text via Whisper using a self-composed domain-hint prompt from god-node labels, then treats transcripts as docs.

nodes.label: add URL ingest & --watch
nodes.rationale: Fetches a URL into ./raw (YouTube/X/arXiv/PDF/image/webpage) then updates the graph; --watch background watcher auto-rebuilds on code changes (LLM only for docs).

nodes.label: GitHub clone & cross-repo merge
nodes.rationale: Clones repos into ~/.graphify/repos and merges multiple graph.json files (each node tagged with repo/origin) for cross-repo or monorepo graphs.
